name: South Town Plaza
summary: South Town Plaza is a community shopping center on West Henrietta Road in Rochester, serving the southern suburbs with a practical mix of retailers and services. With nearly 3,000 reviews and a 4.1-star rating, this accessible plaza has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination for everyday needs.
demographics: South Town Plaza serves a diverse middle-income demographic in the southern Rochester suburbs, attracting families and working professionals from the Henrietta area with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $85,000. The primary trade area draws from suburban neighborhoods within a 5-mile radius, with shoppers typically aged 30-65 who value convenience and accessibility for everyday shopping needs. The center appeals to budget-conscious consumers and families seeking practical retail options, with shopping patterns focused on routine errands, grocery runs, and comparison shopping for household goods.
description: South Town Plaza is a well-established community shopping center located at 3333 West Henrietta Road in Rochester, New York, serving the southern suburbs of the greater Rochester metropolitan area. Strategically positioned in Henrietta, this open-air shopping destination has been a cornerstone of the local retail landscape for decades, providing convenient access to everyday shopping needs for surrounding residential communities. The plaza features a practical mix of national retailers, local businesses, and service providers that cater to the daily needs of Rochester-area families and professionals. With a solid 4.1-star rating from nearly 3,000 Google reviews, South Town Plaza has earned its reputation as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination. Operating daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, the center offers ample parking and easy accessibility from West Henrietta Road, making it a convenient stop for both planned shopping trips and quick errands for the local community.
